units.source_text: 每次考试成绩，信辅都能得到高分。

en.t: On every exam, Shinsuke was able to get high marks.

units.source_text: 但是，操行成绩却都没得过六分（及格分）以上。

en.t: But for conduct, he never received more than six points, the passing mark.

units.source_text: 他每次看到6这个阿拉伯数字，都几乎能听到老师们在办公室的冷笑声。

en.t: Whenever he saw the Arabic numeral 6, he could almost hear the teachers sneering in the staff room.

units.source_text: 事实上，老师用操行分数当盾牌，老嘲笑他也是确实存在的。

en.t: In fact, it was true that the teachers used his conduct score as a shield and kept mocking him.

units.source_text: 他的总成绩因为这个六分，总也无法名列前三。

en.t: Because of that six, his overall marks could never place him among the top three.

units.source_text: 他憎恨这种报复行为，也憎恨这种报复行为的老师。

en.t: He hated this act of retaliation, and he hated the teachers who carried it out.

units.source_text: 到现在——不，直到现在，他已经渐渐忘记当时的这种憎恨。

en.t: By now, no, up to this very moment, he had gradually forgotten the hatred he felt then.

units.source_text: 不过，噩梦不一定就是不幸。

en.t: Still, a nightmare is not necessarily a misfortune.

units.source_text: 至少他因此养成了忍受孤独的性情。

en.t: At least because of it, he developed a temperament capable of enduring loneliness.

units.source_text: 不然他下半辈子所经历的痛苦可能比现在更加痛苦。

en.t: Otherwise, the suffering he experienced in the latter half of his life might have been even more painful than it was.

units.source_text: 他像做梦一样成了一个作家，出版了几本书。

en.t: As if in a dream, he became a writer and published several books.

units.source_text: 然而，他所得到的只有落寞和孤独。

en.t: Yet all he gained was desolation and loneliness.

units.source_text: 已经习惯孤独的今天——或者说除了习惯孤独之外，没有更好的办法的今天，

en.t: Now that he had grown used to loneliness, or rather, now that there was no better way than to grow used to loneliness,

units.source_text: 回忆过去的二十年，那曾经让他憎恨和痛苦的中学校舍，

en.t: looking back over the past twenty years, the middle school building that had once filled him with hatred and pain

units.source_text: 不如说已经照耀在一片美丽蔷薇色的晨光中了。

en.t: seemed, rather, to be already shining in a beautiful rose-colored morning light.

units.source_text: 只剩下操场上枝繁叶茂的白杨树，有寂寥的风吹过……

en.t: Only the leafy poplars on the playground remained, with a lonely wind blowing through them...
